subdivision_of_building: Ground floor and rear part of the building
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan;203-2113 REV A;203-2111 REV A;203-2112 REV B;203-2110;FIRE STATEMENT;DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT;Environmental Noise Assessment.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development shall not be occupied until details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details before the development is occupied or use commences.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The development shall not be occupied until details of the siting, number and design of secure/covered cycle parking spaces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be installed and permanently retained for cycle parking.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

Prior to first use of the development the noise control system as contained within the Environmental Noise Assessment must be installed and permanently retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No plant or equipment shall be affixed to any external face of a building or added to the roof of a building other than that shown in the approved drawings.Reason: In the interest of amenity and to ensure a satisfactory external appearance in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or any amending Order, the premises shall only be used for the sale of hot food takeaway for the sale of hot food where consumption of that food is mostly undertaken off the premises (Sui Generis).Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.

The use hereby approved Sui generis (takeaway) use shall only operate between the hours of 11:00am and 1:00am on Mondays to Saturdays, 11:00am and 11:00pm on Sundays or Bank Holidays.Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers.

Before the use hereby permitted takes place, equipment to control the emission of fumes and smell from the premises shall be installed in accordance with a scheme to be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. All equipment installed as part of the approved scheme shall thereafter be operated and maintained in accordance with that approval and retained for so long as the use continues.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.

The plant shall be supported on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts as necessary to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.
description: Change of use from ground floor shop (Use Class E) to hot food takeaway (Use Class Sui Generis) together with installation of extraction/ventilation pipe at rear.
